claw.title: weekly-follow-up-sweep
claw.description: Every Monday: load the org skill 'follow-up-sweep' and run it exactly as written — overdue follow-ups, leads in Reached Out/Connected with no next step, stalled bizdev-board tasks, deadline clocks inside 21 days. Output per-owner TOP-3 max (four gates: expires soonest / already warm or gated / doable by named owner without an intro / link is the artifact), ~50 words for the main post, aging appendix in thread. Post via slack_post_gated to #standup. Report the two weekly numbers at top: overdue follow-up count and leads that left Identified.

requires: org skill named 'follow-up-sweep' must exist on this deploy — the claw loads it by name and runs it as written
tools: slack_post_gated + crm/taiga read tools in the instance allowed_tools
a notify channel to post the digest to
notes: Monday follow-up pass. Top-3 per owner, aging appendix in thread. The claw body is the schedule and the gates; the method lives in the org skill it loads.
